AnimationSpeedComment: Speed of opening/closing animation (1.0 = normal, 2.0 = twice as fast)
RotationStepDegreesComment: Degrees to rotate per wrench click (positive value; Shift/Sprint reverses). Suggested: 5 to 45
StaggerStrengthComment: Stagger strength settings (how far forward/back items move in Alternating/Random modes)
StaggerForwardOffsetComment: How far forward/back items move when staggered, snapped to voxel increments (0.03125 = 1 voxel, 0.0625 = 2 voxels, 0.09375 = 3 voxels). Safe range: 0.03125–0.15
